listingTitle: Bamboo Bath Mat, 34 x 18 Inch Foldable Roll-Up Wood Bathmat
listingLines: BAMBOO BATHMAT WITH ELEVATED SLATTED DESIGN – Upgrade from a traditional fabric, rubber, or plastic bathmat with a flexible bamboo bath mat made from individual bamboo tiles. The segmented surface creates multiple contact edges underfoot while the open construction allows water and air to move between the pieces. A stylish wood bath mat for bathrooms, tub areas, saunas, spas, and other dry-to-damp spaces.

FOLDABLE & ROLL-UP WOODEN BATHROOM FLOOR MAT – Unlike a rigid wood bathroom mat, the connected bamboo pieces flex so the mat can be rolled or folded for compact storage. The 34 x 18 x 0.3 inch mat weighs approximately 3 lb and rolls to about 6 x 18 inches or folds, making it convenient for smaller bathrooms, RVs, camping, outdoor showers, beach trips, dorm showers, and travel.

BAMBOO CONSTRUCTION WITH NO NAILS OR SCREWS – Individual bamboo sections are joined by strong flexible connecting line rather than metal nails, screws, or staples that can rust in humid environments. Each bamboo piece receives a clear polyurethane protective coating on all sides for short-term water resistance and easier routine cleaning while preserving the natural wood appearance.

UNDERSIDE PADS FOR COMPATIBLE FLOORS – Multiple EVA foam pads underneath help reduce movement and separate the bamboo from the floor surface. Grip performance depends on the flooring material and is generally better on compatible clean or textured surfaces. Always test the bamboo bathroom mat on your flooring before use and discontinue use if it moves unexpectedly.

BATHROOM, SAUNA, SPA, CAMPING & HOME USE – Use as a bamboo bathroom mat outside a shower or bathtub, sauna mat, hot-tub-side mat, outdoor shower platform, camping mat, RV mat, entryway mat, kitchen mat, decorative floor mat, rug underlay, or tabletop protector. Because real bamboo should not remain continuously wet, rinse away soap or residue after wet use and allow the mat to dry completely in a ventilated area. Avoid prolonged soaking or standing water.

It provides an upgrade from traditional fabric, rubber, or plastic bathmats.

faq.question: What material is this bath mat made from?
faq.answer: This bath mat is made of 100% bamboo. Individual bamboo sections are joined by a strong flexible connecting line, rather than metal nails, screws, or staples.

faq.question: Can this bamboo bath mat be stored easily?
faq.answer: Yes, the connected bamboo pieces flex, allowing the mat to be rolled or folded for compact storage. It rolls to about 6 x 18 inches or folds.

faq.question: How should I clean and care for the mat after it gets wet?
faq.answer: After wet use, you should rinse away any soap or residue and allow the mat to dry completely in a ventilated area. Avoid prolonged soaking or standing water, as real bamboo should not remain continuously wet.
